decisions.reason: Original F3 falsely asserts defined first-moment identities for every integrable density. For the normalized Cauchy density 1/(pi(1+x^2)), integral from 1 to R of x/(pi(1+x^2)) equals log((1+R^2)/2)/(2pi), diverging as R tends to infinity; the negative part diverges as well. Repaired F3 separates mass translation from signed-moment translation and assumes a finite absolute first moment for the latter. Step 1.2 derives this from the existing finite second-moment hypothesis using |y|<=1+y^2, and proves shifted second moments finite. The asserted Example is preserved.
